# User Trip Output Schema

The output must be a JSON object with the following root structure:

{
"user_trips": [
{
"trip_id": "string | UUID | optional if generated by the application",
"user_id": "string",

```
  "trip_sequence_number": "integer",

  "started_at": "ISO 8601 timestamp",
  "ended_at": "ISO 8601 timestamp",
  "duration_minutes": "integer",

  "origin_label": "string",
  "origin_city": "string",
  "origin_postal_code": "string | null",
  "origin_country_code": "string",

  "destination_label": "string",
  "destination_city": "string",
  "destination_postal_code": "string | null",
  "destination_country_code": "string",

  "trip_purpose": "commute | education | shopping | leisure | social | errands | healthcare | sports | childcare | business | home_return | other",

  "main_transport_mode": "walking | bicycle | bike_sharing | public_transport | regional_train | long_distance_train | car | car_sharing | e_scooter | ride_hailing | taxi | mixed | other",

  "estimated_distance_km": "number",

  "is_commute": "boolean",
  "is_intermodal": "boolean",
  "is_recurring_pattern": "boolean",

  "generation_rationale": "string | null"
}
```

]
}

## Important Notes

If a stricter runtime schema is provided, the stricter runtime schema overrides this Markdown schema.

Do not generate fields that are not part of the active schema.

Do not omit required fields from the active schema.

Use `null` only for optional fields where no plausible value can be inferred.

`user_id` must exactly match the provided input user.

`trip_id` must be unique within the generated output if it is generated by the model.

`trip_sequence_number` must start at 1 for the first generated trip of this user and increase by 1 for each following trip.

`started_at` must be earlier than `ended_at`.

`duration_minutes` must match the difference between `started_at` and `ended_at` approximately.

`used_provider_name` must come from the user's provided mobility subscriptions if `used_subscription_category` is not `none` or `null`.

Do not generate detailed trip legs in this schema.
